name: Operation Starfire-3
description:
In a harsh environment, the side that better adapts to the conditions has more chances to seize victory. However, who can afford these kinds of sacrifices?
<Originium Altar>Periodically emits Pulse Waves to the surrounding tiles, damaging both allied and enemy units.
<Interference Mine>Upon explosion, deals heavy damage to enemies in the surrounding tiles and amplifies the damage they take for 15 seconds.

tokens.name: Interference Mine
tokens.description: Charges 25 SP, then detonates when a ground enemy enters its small radius. Increases damage taken by 50% for 15 seconds before dealing 2000 True damage. Consumed after use.

abilities.text: More likely to be targeted by attacks.
When coming into contact with a Pulse Wave, this unit instead takes no damage and will deal Arts damage with normal attacks.

Casts Arts periodically, dealing Arts damage equivalent to unit's ATK to all surrounding units
